from: the grouping of the real run of 2026-10-26 (specdraft/e2e-2026-10-26/groups.json, by hand), with group D9 for the cell that rule 6 adds when the reference is the current signed sidecar (specs/reqshield/keylocallock.coroutine.kv)

groups.title: Expiry boundary
groups.question: At exactly the lease end (clock = lease), is a lock that nobody released still held, for tryLock and for the cleanup monitor?

groups.title: Takeover of an expired lock
groups.question: After the lease end, does tryLock take over an expired lock before the cleanup monitor drops it?

groups.title: Lease start after a takeover
groups.question: After tryLock takes over an expired lock, does the new holder's lease start at its own acquisition?

groups.title: unLock of an unbacked permit
groups.question: Does unLock of a permit that no map entry backs (the cap path) return false?

groups.title: Monitor duty after the lease end
groups.question: Must one cleanup monitor step after the lease end drop the entry of a lock that nobody released?
